messages:
sara: Heads up — after the payments service deploy the ExternalSecret annotations didn't seem to trigger a refresh. Pods still have the old DB password. Anyone seen this before?

mike: Which annotation key did you use? can you paste the ExternalSecret YAML (or `kubectl get externalsecret <name> -o yaml`)?

sara: Here's the object I applied:
```
kubectl get externalsecret payments-db -o yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payments-db
  annotations:
    externalsecret.redwood.com/refresh: "true"
spec:
  refreshInterval: 1h
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-payments
```

ben: Ah — that annotation key looks custom. The external-secrets operator expects `external-secrets.io/refresh` (or to use `spec.refreshInterval`). Using `externalsecret.redwood.com/refresh` won't be picked up by the operator.

mike: Yeah — either switch to `external-secrets.io/refresh` or bump the resource (e.g., reapply) to make it re-sync. Quick patch you can run: `kubectl annotate externalsecret payments-db external-secrets.io/refresh=true --overwrite` then check the operator logs.

tanya: Also double-check the Deployment: are you actually consuming the secret generated by the ExternalSecret? We sometimes have a leftover k8s Secret with a different name. `kubectl get deploy payments -o yaml` and look at `envFrom` / `secretKeyRef` names.

sara: Good catch. Deployment is referencing `payments-db-k8s` (an old secret). ExternalSecret creates `payments-db` by default. So even after ExternalSecret sync the pods were reading the stale `payments-db-k8s`.

mike: Two options: update the Deployment to reference `payments-db`, or change the ExternalSecret `spec.target.name` to `payments-db-k8s` so it writes the same secret name used by the Deployment. I usually prefer updating the Deployment so names are canonical. Example patch: `kubectl set env deploy/payments --from=secret/payments-db --overwrite` or update YAML: `envFrom: - secretRef: name: payments-db`.

ben: I'll add a tiny Infra CI lint that warns when an ExternalSecret exists but the Deployments in that namespace reference a different secret name. Filed a quick PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234 — will add the check.

deploy-bot: deployment payments rolled at 2025-03-15T10:12:34Z :rocket:

mike: Once you re-point the Deployment or change the target name, the pods should pick up the new secret on restart. If you want zero-downtime, consider using a sidecar refresh or projected volumes with reload hooks.

sara: Thanks everyone — switching Deployment to `payments-db` now and reapplying. Will follow up in infra board once PR merges. :white_check_mark:

ben: :thumbsup: Also recommend adding a short note in the runbook about expected annotation keys for the operator so people don't invent org-specific keys.

sara: Agree — will update the runbook after the change.
